title: kb configurator tag rules, schema 1
description: configurator/data/tags.json: how GitHub topics of a driver repository become search tags and a category.

categories.description: Every category, in the order that breaks a tie between categories with the same number of tags

drop.description: Topics every driver carries (and the bus names): never tags

allow.description: The tags the page offers as chips

alias.description: A topic spelled another way, to the allowed tag it means

keywords.description: A word of driver.yml description (or the README summary), lower case, to the allowed tag it implies

bus_category.description: Bus to category, the last resort before other
